cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.menu.desc: Makes the selected group copy the position, rotation, scale, visibility or colour of another part (CPM 'Copy Transform'). Only visible in game.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.title: Copy movement from another part
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.intro: '%s' will copy the movement of the part you choose below (CPM 'Copy Transform').
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.lostSource: The part '%s' copied from no longer exists. Pick a new one or remove it.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.additive.desc: On: the copied movement is added on top of this part's own position / rotation / scale. Off: it replaces them.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.multiply.desc: 1 = the same movement, 0.5 = half, 2 = double, -1 = the opposite.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.notInPreview: This does not show in the Blockbench preview, only in game.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.selectOne: Select ONE group (a folder in the outliner) that should copy the movement of another part.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.rootTarget: '%s' is a body part (root). CPM ignores 'copy movement' on body parts: put a group inside it and use that group.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.noSources: There is no other part this group could copy from (it can't copy itself, a group inside it or a part that already copies it).
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.badSource: Pick a part to copy from (it can't be this group, a group inside it or a part that already copies it).
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.done: '%s' now copies the movement of '%s' (only in game)
cpmplus.w3copyxf.ct.nothingTicked: Nothing is ticked: this part will not copy anything. Tick position, rotation, scale, visibility or colour.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.warn.ctMissing: '%s' copies the movement of a part that no longer exists (or is not exported).
cpmplus.w3copyxf.warn.ctMissing.conseque: In game it does not copy anything.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.warn.ctOnRoot: '%s' is a body part (root): CPM ignores 'copy movement' on it.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.menu.desc: Copies the selected cubes onto an armor part, so they show the armor the player is wearing (CPM 'Make Armor Layer').
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.title: Make armor layer
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.intro: %s cube(s) will get a copy on an armor part. The copy follows the original part (copy movement) and uses the armor texture.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.note: The armor part (and the armor1 / armor2 textures) are created if missing. In game the copy shows the armor you wear: test it wearing armor.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.selectCubes: Select the cube(s) that should get an armor layer.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.loose: The cube '%s' is not inside a body part. Put it inside one (head, body, arms or legs) first.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.underArmor: The cube '%s' is already inside '%s' (an armor / cape / elytra part). Select cubes of the head, body, arms or legs.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.unknownRoot: The cube '%s' is inside '%s', which is not a known body part.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.mixedParts: The selected cubes are in different body parts. Make the layer for one body part at a time.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.armor.skipped: (%s already had a copy and were skipped)
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dva.menu.desc: Only in game: the part stops following Minecraft's swing (walking, running, hitting). Only your animations move it. It does not show in the Blockbench preview.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dva.desc: Only in game: the part stops following Minecraft's swing (walking, running, hitting). Only your animations move it.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dva.onlyRoots: 'No Minecraft animation' only works on body parts (root groups). Select only body parts.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.warn.dvaNotRoot: '%s' has 'No Minecraft animation', but that only works on a body part (root). In game it is ignored.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.menu.desc: Makes the selected group the place where an item is held (hand, head, shoulder), or a normal group again.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.title: Item slot
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.intro: Where should '%s' hold an item? Move and rotate the group to place the item.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.label: Slot
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.head: Head item
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.hasContent: This group has cubes or groups inside. CPM does not show what is inside an item slot.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.contentWarn: '%s' has cubes or groups inside. In CPM an item slot does not show what is inside it. Continue anyway?
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.selectOne: Select ONE group (not a body part) to make it an item slot.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.slot.rootRefused: '%s' is a body part (root). Put a group inside it and make that group the item slot.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dup.menu.desc: Creates a copy of a body part (e.g. 'body_dup') that walks with the player but does not swing with arms / legs. Use your own animations to move it.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dup.title: Create body part copy
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dup.intro: The copy walks with the player like the original part. With 'No Minecraft animation' on, it does not swing with arms / legs: only your animations move it (only in game).
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dup.move: Move the %s selected piece(s) into the copy
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dup.exists: '%s' already exists: it is selected now.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dup.done: copy of %s created. It walks with the player but does not swing with arms / legs. Use your animations to move it
cpmplus.w3copyxf.dup.notMoved: %s piece(s) were not moved: they are body parts or inside a rotated group (moving would change where they are). Move them by hand.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.warn.dupNumbered: The group '%s' is not recognised as a body part copy: the name must end in '_dup' (e.g. '%s').
cpmplus.w3copyxf.warn.dupNumbered.conseq: In game this group and everything inside it is missing.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.part.head: Head
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.toggle.desc: Shows the item like CPM's editor shows it. In game Minecraft draws the real item, so it can differ by 1-2 pixels.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.options.desc: Choose which item the preview shows in each hand and on the head.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.title: Item in hand (CPM editor preview)
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.intro: Automatic = like CPM's editor: a Minecraft pose animation (bow, shield, eating...) shows its item; other animations and Edit mode show nothing. Nothing here is saved in the model.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.slot.head: Head
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.noRoot: %s: the model has no part to hold it (the item is hidden)
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.spyglass: The spyglass stays in the HEAD slot (Minecraft decides that). Adjust the head slot.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.poseHint: In game Minecraft raises the arm for the bow, crossbow, shield, trident, spyglass, goat horn, brush and spear. This preview shows the arm where your animation puts it.
cpmplus.w3copyxf.held.fine: Approximate preview; items from mods / resource packs can look different.
